## Description {#details}

<p>Option to specify a tag for the node type.</p>


<p>This option allows a single value type to be inserted in multiple lists simultaneously. See <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/ilist-node">ilist_node</a></em> for usage examples.</p>
